definitions: A secondary ceiling, hung below the main structural ceiling, often used to conceal wiring, pipes, or ductwork, and to provide acoustic or thermal insulation.
A ceiling system consisting of a grid of metal channels and tiles or panels that are laid into the grid.
examples: The office refurbishment included new suspended ceilings.
Access to the wiring is easy with suspended ceilings.
Many modern buildings feature suspended ceilings.
